Pilots and drivers will be replaced eventually. Replacement isn't instant or equal. Replacement is spikey. Elevator operators disappeared and will never come back. As each position disappears, it will never come back. Automation makes more jobs because it makes the tasks humans do in those jobs faster so more of whatever the product is can be made. However, at some point, what the human does in that job will also be automated and then, it will be 100% automated and no more humans will be in that job or task. The reason humans have stayed employed is that automation was not multimodal, it was singular. Singular automation cannot and will not replace humans, it will replace a single task. But multimodal AI combined with humanoid robots is going to replace everyone... eventually. We're at the nascent stages. This isn't going to happen overnight. It will take around 10-30 years to completely replace all human labor... but it will happen.
